items.title: What Happens When AI Becomes Your Gaming Teammate
items.en_title: What Happens When AI Becomes Your Gaming Teammate
items.en_oneliner: AI in gaming has promised smarter NPCs, cheaper content and more dynamic experiences, yet few of those promises have become commercially viable player experiences, and this episode explores that gap.

items.title: Changing acquired studios' core identity consistently leads to doom, says Nightdive Studios CEO
items.en_title: Changing acquired studios' core identity consistently leads to doom, says Nightdive Studios CEO
items.en_oneliner: Nightdive's CEO believes Atari's acquisition approach is worth learning from, as changing an acquired studio's core traits only leads to destruction.

items.title: Warhorse Studios hit by cyberattack, company systems and data affected
items.en_title: Warhorse Studios hit by cyberattack, company systems and data affected
items.en_oneliner: Warhorse Studios suffered a cyberattack with company systems and data accessed without authorization, details still under investigation, a reminder to stay alert about studio data security.

items.title: Sucker Punch lays off 24 to align with 'current market', 'next project needs'
items.en_title: Sucker Punch lays off 24 to align with 'current market', 'next project needs'
items.en_oneliner: Sucker Punch laid off 24 people, about a tenth of the team, officially to align with current market and next project needs.

items.title: Can you build a legitimate video game business on prompts? Meta thinks so
items.en_title: Can you build a legitimate video game business on prompts? Meta thinks so
items.en_oneliner: Meta Horizon VP Saxs Persson calls building games with prompts "the modern way to make video games" — a claim that is far from settled.

items.title: Microsoft offers “voluntary buyouts” to 60,000 employees, including those in Xbox division
items.en_title: Microsoft offers “voluntary buyouts” to 60,000 employees, including those in Xbox division
items.en_oneliner: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to around 60,000 employees, including staff in the Xbox division, as part of a broader restructuring.

items.title: "Developers need to treat Early Access like a real launch, because players do" – Early Access games are on the rise, but so are player expectations
items.en_title: "Developers need to treat Early Access like a real launch, because players do" – Early Access games are on the rise, but so are player expectations
items.en_oneliner: Data shows Steam early access games keep rising in number, and the article reminds developers to treat it like a real launch, because players see it that way.
